name: KV-cache multi-agent structural K2 MA-1 MA-2
purpose: Run the post-item110 Multi-Agent Cross-Block CBJ v0 structural batch: K=2, v14/v16 graph_color, per-agent R in {2,4}, symbolic/oracle cross-block CBJ routing for headline MA-1 and MA-2, plus a secondary model-route autonomous arm. This isolates coordination structure from route accuracy, then separately measures the end-to-end gap when the zero-shot model route is used as router.

provenance.spec: user SPEC Multi-Agent Cross-Block CBJ v0 addendum, MA-1 and MA-2 run contract
provenance.symbolic_execution: Four source-index shards, K=2, v14/v16, R=2,4, n=32 per bin/cell after merge. Cross-block routing is symbolic/oracle lookup from the shared boundary and conflict set. Branch values are symbolic; token counts are Qwen tokenizer prompt-event proxy counts, not generated-token accounting.
provenance.model_route_execution: Secondary arm, four GPU shards on devices 0-3, K=2, v14/v16, R=2,4, n=16 per bin/cell after merge. Only the cross-block route is model-generated; branch values remain symbolic. Invalid route parses fail the row rather than falling back to oracle or chronological routing.

code_added_used.change: Adds run-structural and merge-structural commands for symbolic/oracle K-agent coordination arms, MA-2 monolith controls, tokenizer proxy token accounting, and secondary model-route autonomous routing.

commands.command: Four source-index shards: python -m analysis.kvcache_multiagent_cbj run-structural --bins v14_p04:14:0.4,v16_p04:16:0.4 --scan-limit 400 --n-instances 8 --k-values 2 --r-values 2,4 --node-cap 1200 --agent-order round_robin --arms cbj_cross_block,chronological_cross_block,broadcast,no_coordination --token-accounting tokenizer --device cpu --num-shards 4 --shard-index <0..3>
commands.purpose: Run symbolic/oracle MA-1 coordination arms and MA-2 capacity controls.

commands.command: Four GPU shards: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<0..3> python -m analysis.kvcache_multiagent_cbj run-structural --bins v14_p04:14:0.4,v16_p04:16:0.4 --scan-limit 240 --n-instances 4 --k-values 2 --r-values 2,4 --node-cap 800 --agent-order round_robin --arms model_route_autonomous --include-model-route --max-new-tokens 96 --trace-samples 8 --token-accounting tokenizer --dtype fp32 --device cuda --num-shards 4 --shard-index <0..3>
commands.purpose: Run the secondary autonomous model-route arm without oracle or chronological fallback.

headline.ma1_solve_read: mixed: CBJ beats chronological at R=4 on v14 and v16, ties/loses at R=2, so the low-R solve kill does not fully pass.
headline.ma1_coordination_cost_read: positive: CBJ uses fewer cross-block messages and retractions than chronological and far fewer than broadcast in all symbolic cells.
headline.ma2_capacity_read: mostly positive against monolith-R, mixed against monolith-KR: team beats monolith-R in all cells and matches/beats monolith-KR except v16 R=2 where monolith-KR wins 0.781 vs team 0.750.
headline.model_route_read: secondary gap: model-route parses at 1.0, valid is 0.938-1.0, exact route is only 0.318-0.508 and v16 solve lags symbolic routing.
headline.single_next_move: Report MA-1 as coordination-cost positive but solve-mixed, and MA-2 as team-over-monolith-R positive but not a clean team-over-monolith-KR win. Next extension should test K=3 and v18 only after deciding whether the v16 R=2 monolith-KR negative is acceptable or needs a different partition/ordering preregistered before rerun.

gate_outcomes.number: Symbolic CBJ vs chrono solve: v14 R2 0.938 vs 0.969, v14 R4 1.000 vs 0.969, v16 R2 0.750 vs 0.906, v16 R4 0.969 vs 0.906.
CBJ cross-block messages/retractions are lower than chronological in every symbolic cell; broadcast hits hundreds of messages/retractions and frequent NODE_CAP.
Team matches/beats monolith-KR in 3/4 cells, but v16 R2 loses 0.750 vs 0.781.
Parse=1.0, valid=0.938-1.0, exact=0.318-0.508; v16 model-route solve is below symbolic CBJ.

decision.next_step_routing: Keep symbolic/oracle routing as the headline structural router. Treat model-route autonomous as a secondary gap measurement. Do not claim a clean MA-1 solve win or a clean MA-2 team-over-monolith-KR win from K=2 v14/v16.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish a clean MA-1 solve-rate win at all low R, does not establish a clean team-over-monolith-KR capacity win, and does not establish model-route autonomy as a headline router. It establishes a coordination-cost advantage for symbolic CBJ and a mixed capacity result.
honesty.routing_limit: Headline MA-1/MA-2 use symbolic/oracle route lookup by design, not model reasoning. The model-route arm is secondary and branch values remain symbolic.
honesty.token_limit: Token counts are Qwen tokenizer prompt-event proxy counts for structural events, not actual generated-token accounting except for model-route route prompts.
honesty.implementation_limit: The structural runner uses global suffix rollback after choosing a target checkpoint to keep downstream assignments coherent; it records cascade depth and retractions but is still a symbolic isolation harness, not a full per-agent live KV-cache execution arm.
